findings.text: Tree wide validation entry that starts at the low end, descends to the first leaf, then walks every node in postorder while applying parent slot and limit and child slot checks plus gap checks for allocating trees and a final null adjacency scan.
Caller must hold the tree write exclusion before invoking full validation, guarding the traversal against concurrent structural change.

Every non root cursor must appear exactly once in its parent slot array at the recorded parent slot, with no duplicate reference in any other slot, and the child back pointer must resolve to that same parent.
Every interior node must provide a present child for each slot up to its limit, each child must record the slot index it occupies and must point back to the interior node as its parent.
Pivots within a node must be non decreasing and lie inside the cursor range, the computed data end must equal the last examined slot, and slots beyond that end must stay empty of entries and limits.

Leaves visited in key order must never show two empty entries in a row, each non root node must meet a minimum occupancy, dead nodes are rejected, and allocating trees additionally require gap consistency with a diagnostic dump on mismatch.

Cursor diagnostics distinguish idle and active and start and pause and overflow and underflow and root and error conditions, and separately distinguish invalid stores from new root and root store and exact fit and split store and slot store alongside append and node store and spanning store and rebalance operations.
Diagnostic entry points report cursor identity and range and depth and flags plus write request bounds and node extents, and flag cases where the current index passes the last index.

Pointer array concatenation that counts two null terminated inputs, allocates room for all elements plus a terminator, then fills the new array from the tail so order from the first array followed by the second is preserved.
Concatenation returns a null pointer when the combined allocation cannot be satisfied, leaving the inputs untouched, and callers must handle that failure.
Small identifier allocator where one call obtains an integer region identifier under a reclaim mode and the companion call releases a previously obtained identifier.
Population count over an arbitrary byte range returning the total number of set bits.

Counting first handles leading unaligned bytes one by one, then processes whole words through a bitmap helper with a size guard, then handles any trailing bytes individually so narrow tails stay correct on differing endian order.

Out of line heap helpers that forward initialization and peek and fullness tests and sift operations and bulk build and removal and combined replacement and insertion and indexed deletion to shared inline implementations with element size and callback context.
Word size is 32 with a derived half word base and low and high selectors for portable wide multiplication.
Signed wide multiplication built from unsigned half word products with carry propagation into the high half plus cross terms from mixed halves, without tracing.

Strict hardware address parser that requires full expected length and valid hex digits with separators in fixed positions, leaving the output untouched unless the entire input passes, then decoding each pair into one byte.

Memory error injection state holds a per action table for online and offline transitions plus a notifier block with configurable priority and a control directory handle, created on setup and removed on teardown with cleanup if registration fails.

Network device error injection state holds actions covering registration and mtu change and name change and pre up and type change and post init and pre mtu and upper device changes, with the same priority driven setup and teardown lifecycle as the memory variant.

Shared injection initializer wires a callback and priority into the supplied control block then builds a per action directory tree where each action exposes a writable error value used when that action is notified.
Fixed size attribute kinds map to their native widths while minimum length rules additionally require nested payloads to hold at least a header and millisecond values to hold a wide integer.
Maximum nested policy recursion depth is 10.

Bitfield validation requires a non empty allowed mask and rejects selectors or values outside that mask as well as values that set bits not selected, while array validation skips empty elements and recursively checks each non empty element with increased depth.

Top level parsing guards recursion depth, optionally clears an output table, ignores or rejects unknown types based on strict max type checking, records each accepted attribute, and treats leftover bytes as a warning with optional strict rejection.

Per attribute checks enforce strict mode from a threshold type, exact length expectations with optional strict failure, correct presence or absence of the nested flag, and type specific rules for rejection and flags and integers and strings and binary and nested and nested array payloads including delegated recursion.
